( Who we are )Accepting clients for Q1 2027

We engineer attention.

Attention Labs is a content-led growth agency — a full-stack content studio based in Lucknow, India. We plan, shoot, produce and run content for brands, foundations, organizations, businesses and founders, from the first strategy call to the last published post.

( Our belief )

Most companies rent attention through ads. We help them build media they own: films, channels and social presence that keep working long after the campaign ends.

What we do

( End to end )

We are an end-to-end content partner: one team owns strategy, production, publishing and growth, so nothing gets lost between agencies.

  1. 01Think

    We build the content strategy — for the brand as a whole and for each platform.

  2. 02Make

    We produce brand films, campaign films, shoots, podcasts and everyday social content in-house.

  3. 03Run

    We manage your social channels day to day, from calendars and posting to community and reporting.

  4. 04Grow

    We track what works, double down on it and turn content into reach, trust and demand.

Our services

( 03 disciplines )
01

Production

End to end: concept, script, casting, shoot, edit, colour, sound and final delivery.

  • Brand films that tell who you are and why you matter
  • Campaign films built around a launch, a cause or a moment
  • Shoots: photo and video for products, people, events and places
  • Short-form content: Reels, Shorts and vertical video made for social
  • Podcasts and video series that we build and run for you
02

Social media management

We run your social presence so you don’t have to.

  • Monthly content calendars and posting
  • Copywriting, design and editing for every post
  • Community management: comments, DMs and engagement
  • Monthly performance reports with clear next steps
03

Strategy & implementation

Our strategy team sets the direction, and the same team puts it into action.

  • Brand and content positioning: what you stand for and how you sound
  • Audience research and competitor analysis
  • Content pillars, formats and posting rhythm
  • Separate strategies for each platform
  • Ongoing testing and optimisation based on real data

Every platform has its own audience and its own rules, so we build a separate plan for each one instead of posting the same thing everywhere.

How we work

( 5 steps )

You give us about one interview a month; we handle everything else — and your first assets go live within 2 weeks.

  1. 01

    Discovery call

    We learn your goals, your audience and what has or hasn’t worked so far.

  2. 02

    Strategy

    We set positioning, content pillars and a plan for each platform.

  3. 03

    Production

    We script, shoot and edit films, shoots and social content.

  4. 04

    Publish & manage

    We run your channels, post on schedule and handle the community.

  5. 05

    Measure & improve

    Monthly reports — then we sharpen what works and drop what doesn’t.
